_comment: Published cloud IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges — scan-time IP-prefix BACKSTOP for cloud_ip_check.py (4.7 ruling P3, revised M1). Machine-generated by scripts/asm/refresh_cloud_ranges.py (weekly PR-reviewed refresh). Kept SEPARATE from cloud_providers.yaml (which stays human-authored provider metadata: ASNs/CNAMEs). Read by both scanner and classifier. This seed ships EMPTY — the refresh workflow (refresh-cloud-ranges.yml, workflow_dispatch or weekly cron) populates it on a runner that can reach the provider feeds. Until then the DB device_class read is the sole cloud signal (sufficient for already-classified assets like littleleaffarms).
